01
synthesis

Use common initial steps; after initial growth add extra Cd-oleate/TOP-Se dropwise, then raise temperature

Use common initial steps; after initial growth add extra Cd-oleate/TOP-Se dropwise, then raise temperature. After initial growth, add additional Cd-oleate and TOP-Se dropwise at 270 °C, then grow at 300 °C. Missing fields: dropwise rate, extra precursor formulation, yield. Common parent-route stages are inherited references, not duplicated physical charges: core-charge, core-evacuate, core-inject.
